title: Vaultrix Matador Intl trading / stocks
author: Visible_Demand2587
selftext:
I found this Web app vaultrixmatador.com while looking for trading indicators. I've been testing out a few of their indicators for the last few weeks or so on and honestly they've been pretty damn accurate. Way more onto it than most of the paid stuff I've tried.

The weird thing is I can't find much info about it. There's no real "About Us" page, no info on who owns/runs it, no pricing page. It's just... free.

Has anyone else used it? Does anyone know the background story, who is behind it, or what the business model is? Just trying to figure out if this is legit / new, or if I'm missing something.
